sections.what_happened: Russian forces attacked Ukraine overnight with two Kh-35 air-launched missiles from the Black Sea and 128 drones (65 jet-powered Shaheds, plus Gerbera and Parody decoys) launched from Oryol, Kursk, Millerovo, Primorsko-Akhtarsk, occupied Donetsk, Hvardiiske and Cape Chauda. Ukraine's Air Force says air defences destroyed or jammed 105 UAVs (48 of them jet-powered Shaheds), with hits recorded at 18 locations and debris falls at 9. Ground impact in the same overnight window: drone strikes on Dnipro and Samara injured 3 people and set fire to a house, garages and critical infrastructure (Pravda 05:42+02 = 07:42 , missed catch-up); Russian attacks on four settlements in the Kherson hromada killed 1 and injured 5 (Pravda 07:11+02 = 09:11 , missed catch-up). On the Russian side, Izvestia reported ~50 Ukrainian drones downed over Rostov region overnight with no casualties or ground damage (governor Yuri Slyusar). This is a smaller night than Nov 3 (289 drones, 17 ballistic + 59 cruise missiles) and Nov 4 (130 drones, 7 missiles).
sections.what_verified: Single declared family (Ukrainska Pravda, T3) citing the Ukrainian Air Force (primary source for the figures). No second declared family carried the Nov 5 overnight figures in this scan window; the Nov 4 night's figures were carried by ABC/europesays, which are not the same night's data. Izvestia (no declared tier) corroborates only that an overnight drone exchange occurred, from the Russian side.
sections.what_disputed: Russia's Defence Ministry claims are not in this record for the Nov 5 night; the only Russian-side figure found is Izvestia's ~50 drones over Rostov (no tier, governor-sourced). The 105-downed figure is Ukraine's own count and, like all Air Force tallies, is unverified by independent observers; hit locations (18) are not individually named in the Pravda report.
sections.why_matters: Interceptor Ledger datapoint Short: lead with the hard number — 65 jet-powered Shaheds in one night, 48 of them downed — and the 18 hit locations; the story is the race between faster drones and the interceptors, five days before Abu Dhabi. Do not present the Air Force tally as independently verified.
